steps.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. ONE original standalone landscape 3:2 cinematic editorial photograph. Fictional adult East Asian man with short dark hair and round wire glasses wearing a charcoal knit sweater, seated in profile at a walnut desk in a quiet evening study, right hand writing with a pencil on an open blank notebook, left hand resting on desk. Fully visible head and both hands, waist-up environmental framing. A warm brass desk lamp on left, orderly bookshelves with plain unlettered spines, a tall window on right with blue night sky, repeated rectangular window panes and shelves. Thoughtful focused expression, photographic skin and materials, nuanced warm/cool lighting. No floating surreal objects, no logos, no text, no watermark, no split layout.

Use case: style-transfer. Current study image is only identity/composition input. Follow etched-concept-twin-poster: finished 3:4 portrait two equal stacked independently enclosed landscape windows, upper original photograph, lower black-white copperplate engraving. Fine ivory mounting border with black rules, hard full-width ivory separator. Preserve same man, face, glasses, sweater, writing pose, pencil, notebook, hands, desk, lamp, shelf rhythm, window geometry and camera framing. Lower translates to 19th century etching / wood engraving: fine hatching, crosshatching, stippling, grays formed only by engraved black marks on warm white paper, handcut textures, high-contrast blacks with quiet white breathing areas. Strengthen the existing lamp illumination as a restrained radiating field of engraved lines toward the notebook, emphasize existing repeated shelves as a metaphor for accumulated thought. Do not add unrelated symbols, floating brains or a new world. Preserve photograph scene skeleton and identity. Not a grayscale filter, not sketch tracing, no color in lower, no CGI, no text or logo, nothing crosses frame boundaries.
